title: deliver waits for check runs right after a push
body:
Outcome: deliver waits (bounded) for the PR check runs right after a push instead of exiting 76 "check runs unavailable" while krn/gate is already success or about to report.
Evidence: PR #206 deliver.log under .krn/runs/lead/review-override/: exit 76 with krn/gate already success, resumed with exit 0 by rerunning deliver. Split from t-vxshve4, which fixed the review-side head lag.
Proof: an observer where the check-runs read fails once after the push; deliver reads it again and continues.
Lead trap: a deliver exit 76 'check runs unavailable' right after a push, with krn/gate already reported or pending, is resumed by rerunning the same deliver command.
